headline: Senate closes in on national intelligence chief as Walter Clayton faces confirmation vote Tuesday at 6:30 p.m.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate advanced the Walter Clayton nomination for Director of National Intelligence with a 51-43 cloture vote Monday, clearing the path for a confirmation vote on Tuesday evening. The chamber also passed S. Res. 781 commemorating Juneteenth National Independence Day, and began consideration of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027.
